expected_level_description: You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - log, acknowledge, and track requests to meet time limits - gather and redact information, and draft responses for review - check the identity and authority of the person asking
You can: - log incidents and gather the facts - assess incidents against the organisation's severity criteria - track actions to close
You can: - collect and organise evidence for the annual self-assessment - carry out simple audits, such as access or record-keeping audits - track improvement actions
You can: - check that a request to share information meets policy - keep records of what was shared, with whom, and why - draft simple information sharing agreements
You can: - file, find, and track records correctly - protect records from loss or unauthorised access

You can: - produce well-formatted documents and presentations quickly and accurately - use spreadsheets to sort, filter, and summarise data - use collaboration tools to manage shared documents and versions

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience
